notes: Three routes for the same saying. The first (Qutayba, Malik, Suhayl, his father, Abu Hurayra) is complete in its own text; «فيما قرئ عليه» (read to him) is a mode of transmission, not a name.

The second and third join «ح» and close with «كلاهما عن سهيل، عن أبيه، بإسناد مالك»; each route therefore repeats that tail here, with «بإسناد مالك» as a back reference. Wording differences («إلا المهتجرين») are left out.
